text.en: Horus, this is Stoneclaw Strike. My teacher showed me how to hold my ground.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，这就是岩爪击。我的老师用它教会了我，怎样站稳脚跟。

text.en: I haven't mastered every part of it. I can still keep most trouble at arm's length.
text.zh-CN: 我还没完全掌握它。不过，大多数麻烦，还能挡在一臂之外。

text.en: But the first lesson was a promise: never use it to hurt people who can't defend themselves.
text.zh-CN: 但第一课是一个承诺：绝不用它伤害无力自保的人。

text.en: Then I promise too. I won't use it to bully anyone.
text.zh-CN: 那我也承诺，绝不用它欺负别人。

text.en: Good. Watch my hands. The speech isn't the technique.
text.zh-CN: 好。看着我的手，光会说可算不上学会了。

text.en: (Bootsteps draw closer. Shu breaks off his demonstration.)
text.zh-CN: （脚步声越来越近，舒停下了示范。）
蒙面刺客。他们找到我们了。

text.en: Shu, get Horus out of here. I'll cover your retreat.
text.zh-CN: 舒，带荷鲁斯离开这里。我来掩护。

text.en: Stay close, Horus. We'll get through this.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，别离太远。我们一起闯过去。

text.en: You won't have to do it alone.
text.zh-CN: 你们不用独自面对他们。

text.en: We can talk once we're off this road.
text.zh-CN: 等离开这条路，我们再慢慢说。
